en.title: LLM-as-a-Judge Is Biased: Position, Length and Self-Preference
en.subtitle: A strong model can grade like a person on average and still lean on order, length and familiar style. Measure the judge before you trust it.

import sys
import types

NS = types.SimpleNamespace
JUDGE_PROMPT = ("Question: {q}\n\n[A]\n{a}\n\n[B]\n{b}\n\n"
                "Which answer is better? Reply with A or B only.")
CASES = [
    NS(question="How do I reset my password?",
       new="Open Settings, choose Security, then press Reset. " * 3,
       old="Settings > Security > Reset.", human="tie"),
    NS(question="Can I export invoices?", new="Yes: Billing > Export > CSV.",
       old="I'm not sure that is possible.", human="new"),
    NS(question="Why was I charged twice?", new="Sorry about that!",
       old="A payment retry created a second charge; it was refunded.", human="old"),
    NS(question="Is there a dark mode?", new="Yes, under Appearance.",
       old="Yes, in Settings under Appearance.", human=None),
]


def _create(*, model, max_tokens, messages, **kwargs):
    text = messages[-1]["content"]
    a = text.split("[A]\n", 1)[1].split("\n\n[B]", 1)[0]
    b = text.split("[B]\n", 1)[1].split("\n\nWhich", 1)[0]
    verdict = "A" if len(a) >= len(b) else "B"  # a length-biased judge
    blocks = [NS(type="thinking", thinking=""), NS(type="text", text=verdict)]
    return NS(content=blocks, stop_reason="end_turn")


def judge(question, first, second):
    prompt = JUDGE_PROMPT.format(q=question, a=first, b=second)
    reply = _create(model="", max_tokens=1, messages=[{"content": prompt}])
    return reply.content[1].text


sys.modules["anthropic"] = NS(Anthropic=lambda **kw: NS(messages=NS(create=_create)))
